headline: Sensex and Nifty end flat amid elevated crude oil prices and caution ahead of Fed policy decision

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex and Nifty traded flat as high crude oil prices and cautious sentiment ahead of the US Fed decision capped upside.
Infosys faced selling pressure after receiving four analyst downgrades due to a reduced annual sales outlook.
Axis Bank and Asian Paints emerged as top losers in recent trading sessions.
Investor sentiment remained restrained due to uncertainty surrounding global interest rate paths.
whatHappening: Midcap stocks outperformed the broader market, with the Midcap Index advancing by 565 points.
Key companies including HUL, Hyundai Motors, Vedanta, Bandhan Bank, and United Spirits reported Q2 results today.
US markets ended higher supported by an AI-led rally in tech stocks ahead of the Federal Reserve policy outcome.
Jio Platforms is preparing for its highly anticipated stock market debut on Indian exchanges.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended flat as elevated crude oil prices and caution ahead of the US Fed decision kept gains in check. Midcaps outperformed the broader market, while key corporate earnings from HUL, Vedanta, and Bandhan Bank took center stage. Meanwhile, Infosys suffered multiple downgrades following a weak annual sales outlook.
